Riley (People Ops): Heads-up  multiple teams hit a timing problem when the US cycle overlapped the EU "bridge" holiday. Asking whether we should standardize a small extension policy for cross-region handbacks.
Nora (HR Compliance): Agree we need a standard. Proposal: automatic 48h reviewer extension for any handback that falls entirely inside a documented regional holiday bridge, but managers must confirm via a short CSV so we have attestation.
Sam (Eng Manager): For larger teams, can I apply it to my whole squad in one go?
Riley (People Ops): Yes  we'll accept a bulk CSV from the manager email. Minimal header: manager_email,region,reviewee_emails,form_ids,reason,approved_by,approval_ts
Example row: sam@redwood.ai,EU,"jin@redwood.ai,amy@redwood.ai","form_8801,form_8802",holiday bridge,Riley,2026-08-15T09:00:00Z
Ava (Calibration Chair): Chairs request that any bridge-extended items are appended to the calibration packet with flag "bridge-extension" and audit id so medians can be computed both with and without them. Also add a promotion-impact column.
Jin (IC): Just checking  my self-review timestamp stays the same, right? I don't want an extension to affect my on-time record.
Nora (HR Compliance): Correct  self-review timestamps are immutable. The extension only applies to reviewer/manager handback windows and is flagged for analytics.
ops-bot: System: deadline enforcement ran at 2026-08-16T23:59:00Z for global. Manual bridge extensions require People Ops job.
Riley (People Ops): Ops notes: 1) Send CSV to people-ops@redwood.ai 2) We'll run a scoped "bridge-extension" job within 4 business hours 3) Job will reopen/extend the specific handbacks, attach immutable audit entries (BRG-####), and update the calibration appendix. Please tell reviewers NOT to re-upload attachments until you receive audit ids.
Sam (Eng Manager): Sending CSV now for my 4 reports. Thanks.
Riley (People Ops): Job complete  applied 4 rows. Audit IDs: BRG-1101, BRG-1102, BRG-1103, BRG-1104. Appendix "bridge_extensions_august_2026.csv" added to the packet. Chairs and compliance notified.
Ava (Calibration Chair): Received. We'll run medians both ways and note any promotion-impact items in the packet.
Riley (People Ops): Adding the CSV template and short how-to to the review ops page so managers can self-serve next cycle. Closing loop.
